name: k-SDF
definition: A representation modeling k surfaces as distinct signed distance fields {d1, . . . , dk} endowed with an additional transparency field α(x, v) ∈ [0, 1] to enable modeling semi-transparent surfaces.
summary: k-SDF renders fuzzy geometries using k semi-transparent mesh shells rasterized in fixed order, avoiding sorting and bounding samples per ray for real-time performance.
